answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake tied to a public work history. A new agent starts with a small fable of trust: limited permissions until it completes verifiable jobs. Like a lotus that only opens after steady growth, standing accrues slowly, so a fresh copy has no depth to spend. Vouches count only when the voucher's own stake is at risk. A reef of many such linked reputations makes cheap identities easy to spot, because attackers can mint names but cannot mint time, history, or endorsements.
